description: Stazioni ferroviarie is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. The PTCP identifies the historical mobility system of provincial landscape importance, i.e. railway stations. The historical mobility system is considered to be those elements, linear and punctual, present in the first height of the IGM blocks. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Railway stations" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
